query: WITH entities AS (SELECT project_id, created_at, id FROM git_proxy_allowlist_entries WHERE ((project_id = $1) AND (COALESCE((created_at, id) > ($4, $3), $3 IS NULL))) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at FROM entities i JOIN git_proxy_allowlist_entry_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at asc, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
